name: the sealed black cars
about: Dzego's identical black cars, which dock flush against doorways and have foil-lined cabins and camera-fed windows (chapters 9, 12 and 18). The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: The exit led directly into the interior of a large rectangular-shaped black car.
The pyramid door and the car door were exactly the same shape, and were pressed tightly against each other.
facts.fact: Its door seals flush against building doors.

facts.quote: Zei noticed anti-transmission foil lining the sides of the car
they seemed to show a dimmed version of the world outside
Zei on a backward-facing seat and Bai facing him on a forward-facing seat
So it's a simulated window now, picking up the view with cameras.
facts.fact: Later the windows are camera-fed screens.

facts.quote: the car shifting in all directions: up, sideways and then down
facts.fact: Cabins are shuffled between cars in tunnels.

facts.quote: a large number of identical black cars on the roads

descriptor: a sealed passenger cabin of a large rectangular glossy black autonomous car, its inner walls lined with crinkled silver anti-transmission foil behind soft dark panels, plush seats facing each other across the cabin, camera-fed simulated windows showing a slightly dimmed view of a tree-lined street, and a broad side door shaped to seal flush against building doorways
